sprint_goal: Complete frontend-backend integration of the Prompt Tracking page (/prompt-tracking) — replace all mock data with real API calls following the 4-layer pattern (types/api/adapters/hooks).
sprint_status: COMPLETE — 8 new frontend files, 3 refactored components, 2 deleted mock files. Backend: start_date/end_date on 3 endpoints. 67 DT tests passing. Build clean (0 TS errors).
constraints: Backward compatibility with existing artifacts — all Pydantic fields must have defaults
Raw SDK clients for gap analysis + content engine (no LangChain wrappers)
OpenRouter via openai SDK (AsyncOpenAI/OpenAI with base_url override, max_retries=0)
LangGraph >=1.0 interrupt model: check __interrupt__ in result dict, not GraphInterrupt exception
Default-deny middleware — all routes protected unless explicitly whitelisted
core/ cannot import from api/ — shared code goes in core/shared_tools/
DATABASE_URL is REQUIRED — no JSON fallback for TaskStore or AuthService
REDIS_URL is REQUIRED — no in-memory fallback for EventBus or checkpointer
Async Redis for hot paths (pipeline writes), sync Redis for locks + sync readers
Distributed locks are fail-closed when Redis is configured (no split-brain fallback)
CSP strict-dynamic disabled in dev (blocks Next.js HMR)
handleUnauthorized must skip redirect when on auth pages (prevents loop)
useSearchParams() requires Suspense boundary in Next.js 14 App Router
OPENROUTER_API_KEY is REQUIRED for Content Engine, Topic Discovery, Perplexity research, CE-0 Planner, AP-1 Suggester, GA-S8 Report, GA Perplexity Engine
VSG-1 author discovery stays on litellm (Anthropic web_search_20250305 tool not supported by OpenRouter)
Gap analysis engines (Claude/Gemini/OpenAI) stay on native SDKs (web search / grounding / reasoning not supported by OpenRouter)
GA Perplexity engine NOW on OpenRouter (Phase 2) — AsyncPerplexity no longer used
environment_notes: Key deps: LangGraph >=0.2, langsmith >=0.2, litellm >=1.50 (VSG-1 only), openai >=2.0 (OpenRouter + native), sqlalchemy[asyncio] >=2.0.30, structlog >=24.1, redis[hiredis] >=5.2.0, perplexityai >=0.2 (GA engine only)
